## Pull Request

### Type of Change

- [ ] `feat` — New feature, report, or benchmark
- [ ] `fix` — Bug fix (linter, regex, broken links)
- [ ] `docs` — Documentation update
- [ ] `refactor` — Code restructuring (no behavior change)
- [ ] `ci` — CI/CD pipeline changes
- [ ] `chore` — Maintenance

### Description

A concise description of what this PR does and why.

### Related Issue(s)

Closes #

### Checklist

- [ ] I have read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] My changes follow the project's style guidelines.
- [ ] I have run the CRUCIBLE linter on all new/modified report files and they return `[PASS]`.
- [ ] I have added/updated documentation as needed.
- [ ] My commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).

### CRUCIBLE Linter Output (if applicable)

If this PR adds or modifies files under `showcase/` or `benchmarks/`, paste the linter output:

```
python scripts/crucible_linter.py <path-to-file>
```

### Methodology Impact (if applicable)

If this PR modifies anything under `docs/`, `templates/`, or `scripts/crucible_linter.py`:

- **Which layer(s) are affected?**
- **Does this change the analytical behavior of CRUCIBLE?** (Yes/No)
- **Has this been discussed in a linked Issue first?**

### Screenshots / Examples (if applicable)

Add any visual evidence or before/after comparisons.
